title: Eagle Owl, 500 CFA francs, Save The World Collection

specs.Decoration: digital printing, laser frosting, magnifying lens

descriptionPlain: Description Each continent carries its own stories of animals and ecosystems that today require special care. The “Save the World” series highlights the interdependence between humanity and nature. At the center of each composition, a vivid, fullcolor illustration presents a species characteristic of a given region, rendered with photographic attention to detail. The monochromatic hands at the base of the design reinforce the meaning of the concept. It is humankind that holds the fate of the animal world in its hands.
